about: Halo 3's own multiplayer announcer, read from the player's MCC FMOD banks (halo3/fmod/pc/*.fsb + .fsb.info). HaloBridge matches each row against the source paths in the .info files, decodes the sample with vgmstream and plays it when the mod reports the event.

columns.match: substrings tried in order against .fsb.info source paths (lower-case, backslashes)

rows.rule: two kills less than 4 s apart (Halo's multi-kill window)
three kills chained within 4 s of each other
all four gauntlet kills without dying (the gauntlet's spree; Halo needs 5, the gauntlet has 4 fighters)
